summary: Defines UI components and functionalities for the Welcome Staff Admin page.
purpose: To provide a user interface for staff admin to interact with and manage data, using controls like dropdowns and text inputs.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Setup HSPnet page with user session.
Register client script includes for 'WelcomeStaffAdmin.js' and 'Date.js'.
Set initial dropdowns and date pickers.

workflows.name: Dropdown Event Handling
steps: Handle events for discipline and site dropdowns to refresh data.

workflows.name: Data Refresh
steps: Rebind gvwApplications to reflect current selections and dates.

system_behavior: Handles dropdown changes and refresh of data accordingly.
Provides a calendar UI for date entry.
